title: Edges File
description: Schema for the taxonomy edges file (edges.json). Contains the canonical edge type registry and all edge instances connecting taxonomy nodes. Edge types follow AIF (Argument Interchange Format) conventions. QBAF mapping note: SUPPORTS, CONTRADICTS, WEAKENS, and ASSUMES are mapped to QBAF strength computation; RESPONDS_TO, TENSION_WITH, INTERPRETS, and CONVERGES_WITH are currently semantically inert in strength computation (mapping decision tracked separately in B-305).

_doc.description: Documentation string describing the file's purpose

last_modified.description: Last modification date in ISO 8601 format (YYYY-MM-DD)

edge_types.description: Canonical edge type registry. Exactly 8 types aligned with Resolve-EdgeType.ps1.

edges.description: All edge instances connecting taxonomy nodes

CanonicalEdgeType.description: The 8 canonical edge types. Source of truth: scripts/AITriad/Private/Resolve-EdgeType.ps1.

description.description: Human-readable description of the edge type's semantics

direction.description: Whether the relationship is directional (source→target) or bidirectional

domain.description: Domain constraint description for valid source/target node types

bidirectional.description: Whether this edge represents a bidirectional relationship

confidence.description: Confidence that this edge genuinely exists (0.0-1.0). Only edges ≥0.5 should be proposed.

weight.description: Relationship strength independent of existence confidence (0.0-1.0)

modulated_weight.description: Weight modulated by endpoint confidence/priority. Computed by modulateEdgeWeights.ts.

rationale.description: Explanation of why this edge exists, referencing both node contents

model.description: AI model that discovered/proposed this edge
